prompt_text: Where is the best place to get an oil change in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you want the fastest/cheapest place, a higher-end shop that will do OEM-spec service, or a mobile service that comes to you? Tell me your preference (and your zip or cross-street and car type) and I can give names/address/phone for nearby shops. Meanwhile, quick guidance:

Chain quick-lubes (fast, convenient)
- Valvoline Instant Oil Change, Jiffy Lube, Firestone Complete Auto Care, Midas — pros: fast (15–45 min), transparent pricing, often run coupons; cons: some locations upsell, may not use OEM-specified parts unless you ask.

Independent shops (often better value and personalized service)
- Local independent auto shops and AAA-approved shops in Pleasanton can be more thorough and better at diagnosing other issues. Ask about experience with your car make and whether they use OEM-spec oil/filters.

Mobile services (convenient, do at home/work)
- YourMechanic, Wrench and similar mobile techs will change oil at your location and often use quality filters/oils. Good if you prefer no trip to a shop.

How to pick the best place
- Check Google and Yelp ratings and read recent reviews (last 6 months).
- Call and ask: total price for your car (conventional vs full synthetic), brand/type of oil and filter, whether a new drain plug washer is used, and what’s included (top-offs, fluid checks).
- Verify they recycle used oil and give a printed invoice showing mileage (useful for warranty/records).
- If your car is under warranty, confirm they’ll use the manufacturer’s spec and record service properly.

Typical price & time
- Conventional oil: roughly $30–60; full synthetic: $60–120 (varies by vehicle).
- Time: 15–45 minutes at quick-lubes; 1–2 hours at busy independent shops; mobile visits vary.

If you want, give me your zip or exact location in Pleasanton and whether you prefer a quick-lube, independent shop, or mobile service, and I’ll list a few highly-rated nearby options with contact suggestions.
